column1: # layers.tsv (harbor#1149, DESIGN.md v2.1) - which tracked paths are core (shared by `harbor deploy push`) and which stay in the dev repo.
# Columns, tab-separated, one header row:  path  layer  note
#   path   a directory prefix ending in "/", or one exact file path. Rows must not overlap.
# Every tracked path matches exactly one row. bin/layers.sh --check is red on a path that matches none or two: there is no default layer.
# Classified by what the files ARE. A core path that still names a client or account is a leak to fix, never a reason to move the row.
# Known gap: a core test that reads a dev path (EVALS-DATA/) fails in the exported repo; harbor#1149.
# A core document NAMES a dev path in code font and never links it: a link dangles in the export (tests/export/selfcontained.test.sh).
# Each top-level entry's kind and #949 layer are in CONTRACTS/layout-map.tsv (harbor#1272); whether it ships is only ever read from here.
# Known gap: untracked files are in neither the export nor the --check; commit a file to classify it.
